name: Yurt Hideaway
signature: A 6-metre traditional Mongolian yurt in Tootgarook with a private fenced courtyard — five minutes from Peninsula Hot Springs, 4.97 stars across 100% recommendation rate
editorNote:
A single 6-metre traditional Mongolian yurt on a residential block in Tootgarook, with a private fenced courtyard, separate en-suite bathroom, and an outdoor kitchenette. Five minutes from Peninsula Hot Springs. Hosted by yoga instructors with a 4.97-star Airbnb rating and a 100% recommendation rate across verified reviews — the consistent host quality is the product, not the novelty of the format.

Designed for couples; no TV by design. The combination of price (from $320/night, with discounts for three nights or more), PHS proximity, and host attentiveness makes it the most compact thermal-adjacent stay on the Peninsula. Dog policy not confirmed — contact the host directly if dogs are relevant.
whyWeGo: Five minutes from Peninsula Hot Springs, 4.97-star host rating — the most compact and host-attentive thermal-adjacent option on the Peninsula.
ifOnlyOneThing: Book for three nights or more for the rate discount — and plan an early PHS session on at least one morning.
